name: Tag
summary: A pill label that can be plain, removed with a close button, or selected like a checkbox.
description: Use tags for filters, chosen options and keywords people manage. For read-only status, use a badge, which is smaller and quieter.

classes.name: v-tag
classes.description: The tag. On a <label> around a checkbox, or a <button aria-pressed>, it becomes selectable with a control-strength border.

classes.name: v-tag-remove
classes.description: The close button inside a removable tag: a 24px round target at the end.

states.description: On the checkbox inside a label tag: fills with the accent and adds a check mark.
On a button tag: the same selected look. Your script flips it.
On the checkbox or button: dimmed and not clickable.

hooks.name: data-v-dismissable
hooks.description: Marks the tag as the thing a close button inside removes.

hooks.name: data-v-dismiss
hooks.description: Removes the closest [data-v-dismissable] on click and moves focus to the next control.

events.name: v:dismiss
events.description: Fires before the tag is removed. Call preventDefault() to keep it, e.g. to remove it yourself after a server call.

keyboard.action: Moves to each selectable tag and each remove button.
Selects or clears a checkbox or button tag.
On a remove button, removes the tag; focus moves to the next control.

a11y: Give each remove button an aria-label that names the tag, such as "Remove Galway", not just "Remove".
A selected tag gains a check mark as well as the fill, so the state never rests on colour.
Group selectable tags in a <fieldset> with a <legend> so screen readers know what is being chosen.
After a tag is removed focus moves to the next control (or the previous one), not to the top of the page.
